unit.title: More Letters of the Gurmukhi Alphabet

contentBlocks.text: This week you learned ten new letters! Let's practice all twenty-one letters you know so far, from the very beginning.

Say all twenty-one letters in order, from the very first ones you learned: ura, aira, iri, sassa, haha, kakka, khakha, gagga, ghagha, ngangga, chachha, then this week's: chhachha, jajja, jhajha, tainka, thattha, dadda, ddhadha, nana, tatta, thatha. Notice the pattern in the last two rows especially — tongue-curl sounds, then similar-but-different tongue-to-teeth sounds.
Twenty-one letters — more than half the Gurmukhi alphabet! Wonderful work these past two weeks. Keep practicing saying them all in order.

objectives: Recite all twenty-one letters learned across weeks 1 and 2, in order
Distinguish the retroflex row (ਟਠਡਢਣ) from the dental row (ਤਥ) by feel
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Recite all twenty-one letters together, in order, from the very first lesson.
2. Pay special attention to the retroflex-vs-dental contrast from this week.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing two full weeks — twenty-one letters, more than half the alphabet!
differentiationTips: Struggling: break the recitation into the same chunks used across the two weeks (groups of 2-3) rather than requiring all 21 in one unbroken sequence
Ready for more: ask the child to sort this week's ten letters into two groups by feel — tongue-curl vs. tongue-to-teeth — without looking at the list
This is a good checkpoint to note which specific letters or sounds need the most repetition before continuing to new rows
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recitation and tracing review — check that the child can name and trace all ten of this week's letters (ਛ ਜ ਝ ਟ ਠ ਡ ਢ ਣ ਤ ਥ), and recite the full 21-letter sequence with reasonable fluency.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates two full weeks of the Painti Akhari sequence (21 of 35 traditional letters) before the unit continues, matching the 'consolidate before adding more' pacing established across this session.

generationData.instructions: Trace each of this week's letters one more time, and say its name out loud.
